title.value: Towards an efficient and risk aware strategy for guiding farmers in identifying best crop management
title.justification: The title directly aligns with the content of the paper, which discusses strategies for guiding farmers in crop management using a bandit algorithm.
title.quote: Towards an efficient and risk aware strategy for guiding farmers in identifying best crop management

extractions.description: This paper presents a strategy for guiding farmers in identifying the best crop management practices using a bandit algorithm. The authors propose a risk-aware approach to minimize farmers' losses during the identification of optimal fertilizer practices, using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) and Yield Excess (YE) as metrics. The study demonstrates the effectiveness of the bandit algorithm over traditional methods through simulations in Southern Mali, focusing on nitrogen fertilization for maize production.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing crop management strategies to minimize environmental impact and improve efficiency, which directly relates to sustainable agriculture practices.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Identifying site-specific best-performing crop management is crucial for farmers to increase their income from crop production, but also for minimizing the negative environmental impact of cropping activities.

primary_category.justification: The paper addresses reducing environmental impacts and increasing efficiency in agriculture through advanced management practices, aligning with Climate Change Mitigation goals.
primary_category.quote: Identifying site-specific best-performing crop management is crucial for farmers to increase their income from crop production, but also for minimizing the negative environmental impact of cropping activities.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper deals with adapting crop management strategies to changing weather patterns, which is a key aspect of climate change adaptation.
secondary_categories.quote: Due to weather variability, the identification of these practices can be challenging, in particular with rainfed farming: what worked best in a wet year, might not work in the next season, when rainfall is less.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper is focused on improving agricultural practices by identifying optimal crop management strategies, specifically through nitrogen fertilization techniques.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our objective was to provide an identification strategy using a bandit algorithm that was better at minimizing farmers’ losses occurring during the identification, compared with the “intuitive strategy”.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The focus on providing decision support for farmers to optimize crop management aligns with supporting farmer resilience.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Computer-based decision support tools can allow farmers to make more informed (less uncertain) decisions about their cropping practices from one year to the next, and can facilitate farmers’ risk management in the face of seasonal weather variability.

applications.value: Improving nitrogen fertilizer practices to enhance crop yield and minimize environmental impact
applications.justification: The paper discusses optimizing nitrogen fertilizer use to improve yield and reduce negative environmental effects, a clear application in sustainable agriculture.
applications.quote: We focus on nitrogen fertilization. Tailoring nitrogen fertilizer recommendations to farmers’ contexts is known to be challenging.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper fits well within existing categories related to agriculture and climate change mitigation, specifically in optimizing resource use.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's focus on agricultural practices and fertilizer optimization is well-covered under the existing sub-category of Agriculture.
